_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Culture extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes + active diagnosis ids (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53), then expanded through this table (L55-69) so it matches the activations' FREE-TEXT diagnosticTriggers. In Culture the condition-codes (identity_fracture, heritage_loss...) and diagnosis ids never textually equal an activation.diagnosticTrigger (e.g. 'Elder knowledge loss'); this table bridges them.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(culture-pulse-engine.js computePulse inline map, L131-160)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-gate, L170-173)--> diagnosis id --(culture.json issues[]._authored circuit)--> circuit nodeIds --(those nodeIds' activation.diagnosticTriggers = FREE-TEXT phrases)--> protective trigger strings. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data). The condition-codes section adds the pulse-engine family hop.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family present in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the ACTUAL code gate, requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, L170-173 - NOT primaryIndicators). A condition that is only a diagnosis secondaryConfirmation but does NOT emit that diagnosis requiredFamily is listed under secondaryDiagnoses and NOT folded (bias against over-marking). Example: structural_stress is CREATIVE_STAGNATION.secondaryConfirmation but emits only structural_event, not in CREATIVE_STAGNATION.requiredFamilies (creative_event/institutional_event), so it is UNMAPPED, not folded.
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from culture.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinanceAndEnergy: (1) DIRECTION OF TRIGGERS: Culture activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases (e.g. 'Literacy decline') - the ENERGY pattern, NOT the Finance pattern (Finance triggers were diagnosis-ids that self-match). So in Culture the diagnoses map is NOT redundant for direct matching; the free-text expansion is load-bearing. (2) No separate exogenous classify() vocabulary: Culture's condition tokens ARE the contract indicators, mapped to families inline in computePulse (like Finance's inline classify). (3) UNMAPPED condition codes: 3 (culture_high_stress and structural_stress emit only structural_event, which no contract requires; macro_shock emits macro_event, a dead-end - identical to Finance macro_shock). (4) ORPHAN activations: 2 (CBLM/Dance, M1/Sports) - fewer than Finance (3). (5) REVERSE ORPHAN unique to Culture: node DMN appears in two _authored circuits (CENSORSHIP, IDENTITY_CRISIS) but has NO activation object in culture.json, so it contributes no protective triggers - a gap Finance/Energy did not exhibit.

conditionCodes.reason: computePulse maps culture_high_stress -> structural_event (L158), but NO EVIDENCE_CONTRACT lists structural_event in requiredFamilies. Dead-end family: reaches no diagnosis, hence no _authored circuit, hence no activation. This is the stress catch-all token; contracts set catchAllBlocked:true precisely to reject a diagnosis activated by this without real family evidence.

computePulse maps structural_stress -> structural_event (L158). It is CREATIVE_STAGNATION.secondaryConfirmation, but the gate is requiredFamilies (creative_event/institutional_event) and structural_event is not among them, so it never satisfies the gate. Not folded (fold-bias). No grounded alias.
computePulse maps macro_shock -> macro_event (L159), but no contract consumes macro_event. Dead-end, identical to Finance macro_shock. No grounded alias.

activationsWithTriggersButNoTriggerSourc.reason: Activation has diagnosticTriggers but its brainNodeId appears in NO issue._authored circuit and no condition-code chain reaches it. Needs authoring into an issue circuit before extinction should touch it. (Culture analog of the Finance SMA/AMY/INS orphans; Culture has TWO.)
